title: Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Scorpion EXO Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1 is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1133g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~98 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Retro open face with internal sun visor and fiberglass shell.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Open-face design with extended neck coverage; Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1 features a unique 'Flow' shape that accommodates larger head shapes and offers a roomier fit compared to standard oval helmets. The TC-1 model includes an integrated sun visor.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Scorpion EXO Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Scorpion EXO Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Scorpion EXO Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Scorpion EXO's Open Face lineup, the Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Scorpion EXO Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1 represents Scorpion EXO's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Scorpion EXO Scorpion Belfast Flow TC-1 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
